programme.title: Демоны
programme.desc: Роман, спасая девушку-мулатку от скинхедов, получает резиновую пулю в затылок. Он жив, но находится в состоянии комы. От Никсона Демон узнаёт, что Вована досрочно с зоны "выкупил" Серый - тоже "безбашенный" блатной из окружения Никсона. Он же и стрелял в Демона и Никсона из автомата. Люди Никсона его уже ищут. Никсон намекает Демону, что "крысой" может оказаться Головастик. Вернувшись домой, Демон узнаёт от Кораблёва, что Алла ушла от него, забрав сына. Головастик выяснил, что отец Стивена - самый настоящий американский мафиози. А ещё Головастик вычисляет адрес подонков, ранивших Рому. Демон и Лёня приезжают к ним и всаживают в каждого по резиновой пуле. Демон пытается вывести Головастика "на чистую воду".

programme.title: Демоны
programme.desc: В конце прошлого века Дмитрий Назаров, носящий кличку "Демон" был лидером преступной группировки. Прошли годы, и уже в новом веке Демон возглавил вполне легальный бизнес. Но не всем так повезло, как Демону. Кому-то прошедшие годы пришлось провести в тюрьме, как, например, бывшему его подельнику Ацамазу Тагурову. И вот Демон узнает, что через 16 лет вышел на свободу Ацамаз. Проблема в том, что группа Демона в 1994 году взяла в одном банке кредит, который не вернула. И вот Ацамаз утверждает, что выкупил долю Демона и имеет подтверждающие это бумаги. Он хочет получить 2 миллиона. Возвращение Ацамаза встревожило Демона, и на другой день на обычную утреннюю пробежку он прихватил с собой пистолет. И оказался прав, опередив человека, переодетого бомжем, готового выстрелить в него из пистолета с глушителем. Демон понимает, что за Ацамазом стоит кто-то очень серьёзный, и два миллиона - это только предлог. Эти люди хотят отобрать у Демона всё! А это значит, придется вновь собрать "под ружьё" старую боевую команду...

programme.title: Почта
programme.desc: В почтовое отделение на должность экспедитора устраивается Елена (40 лет). Экспедитор Андрей (45) не очень доволен новой напарницей, он не доверяет женщинам за рулем. Но со временем между Еленой и Андреем возникает симпатия. И не без стараний со стороны их детей – Юли и Глеба. Андрей – одинокий папа, Елена - одинокая мама, казалось бы, ничего не может помешать их отношениям… Но тайны и ошибки прошлого сыграют с ними злую шутку… Бушуют страсти и в почтовом отделении. Руководитель отделения Артем (30) покоряет вершины почтовой карьеры и не желает замечать сотрудницу отделения Милану (25), которая мечтает заполучить его сердце. Мама Артема и его младший брат Гена также вносят в жизнь отделения свои коррективы… Все герои ежедневно сталкиваются с нестандартными ситуациями, но не остаются равнодушными к проблемам людей-клиентов почтового отделения, помогая им выпутаться из сложных историй…

programme.title: Контакт
programme.desc: Спецслужбы проводят взрывные работы на участке, где зафиксированы магнитные аномалии. Совершенно случайно в зоне взрыва оказываются три человека: преступник Владимир Голенко, фотохудожник Олег Малинин и неудачливый писатель Венедикт Тартаковский. В результате взрыва между этими людьми возникает странная связь – фотограф Малинин может читать мысли преступника Голенко, и даже видеть окружающий мир его глазами, а писатель Тартаковский может полностью управлять действиями Голенко и при этом общаться с Малининым на расстоянии. Тартаковский, получив в свое полное распоряжение преступника Голенко, решает его руками отомстить всем, кто мешал ему в жизни. Город захлестывает череда кровавых преступлений...

programme.title: Спецы
programme.desc: Криминалисты Макаров, Ройзман и Ким выезжают "на тело". Макаров – новый нач.лаборатории ЭКЦ. На месте он знакомится со следователем Богданой Ковальской и операми Щегловым (Демоном) и Киценко. Версии Богданы и Макарова расходятся, но уступать ни один из них не хочет. Богдана встречается с судебным прокурором Игорем Карпенко, но он женат и трепещет перед своей женой Аллой, хотя и постоянно обещает Богдане развестись. Алла подозревает мужа в измене, но доказательств у нее нет. Подруга Богданы – Вера – с интересом относится к появлению Макарова. Как оказалось, Макарова на должность "продвинул" его бывший коллега и друг – полковник Туманов. У Макарова происходят столкновения с Богданой на профессиональной почве. Месяц назад убили сестру-близнеца Макарова – Иру. Убийцу не нашли, дело закрыли. Макаров собирается сам продолжить расследование, используя допуск к делу, который у него теперь есть.

programme.title: Спецы
programme.desc: Макаров приходит к приятелю – Виктору Берштадскому, с которым они дружат с детства. У него своя частная лаборатория "Спектр". Богдана опять забывает забрать дочку Яну из танцевального кружка. С Макаровым она по-прежнему в контрах, однако вынуждена признать, что спец он отличный. В жизни Игоря Карпенко намечается карьерный рост. У Киценко появляется подружка – аспирантка-филолог. В кабинете у Богданы Макаров знакомится с ее дочкой – Яной. Продолжая расследовать убийство сестры Ирины, Макаров вспоминает свой последний разговор с ней. Она рассказала ему, что у нее на операционном столе умер пациент. Макаров выясняет имя погибшего – Илья Кошевой. Богдана признается Карпенко, что устала от их отношений. Ей нужен муж, а Яне – отец. Вечером Макаров встречается в баре с Берштадским. Он уверен, что сестру убили преднамеренно. Подняв дело об убийстве сестры, он увидел, что на щеке у мертвой Иры был след в виде змейки. На снимках, найденных в Интернете, на пальце у жены Ильи Кошевого, Инги, Макаров замечает тяжелое кольцо в виде змейки.

programme.title: Спецы
programme.desc: В лабораторию приходит новый сотрудник – Олеся Бильчак. Макаров недоволен тем, что полковник Туманов прислал к нему столь юную и неопытную сотрудницу. Но Леся – любимая племянница Туманова. Между Лесей и Щегловым возникает симпатия. Ким, Ройзман и Смирнитский разыгрывают Лесю, заперев ее в комнате с трупами и выключив свет. Однако она показывает себя молодцом. Макаров по-прежнему ведет себя с Богданой заносчиво и самоуверенно. Карпенко привозит Богдану в ресторан на окраине города. Но там они натыкаются на подругу Аллы. Чтобы она не заметила их, они сбегают из ресторана, так и не поужинав. Игорь бросает Богдану одну. Богдана рассказывает Вере о том, как Карпенко "кинул" ее в ресторане. Вера советует Богдане, наконец, решиться и бросить Карпенко. Стас Ким выясняет, что Инга Кошевая – кинолог. Макаров едет в клуб кинологов, знакомится с Ингой. Он видит у нее на пальце кольцо со змейкой, приглашает ее попить кофе. А затем незаметно крадет ее стаканчик, чтобы впоследствии снять с него отпечатки пальцев. Это воровство замечает приятель Инги – Олег.

programme.title: Спецы
programme.desc: Карпенко приходит к Богдане с букетом цветов и с извинениями. Он кается. Богдана старается "поставить вопрос ребром", но Карпенко заговаривает ей зубы. Леся просит у Макарова, чтобы он доверил ей настоящую работу. Он предлагает ей еще раз тщательно осмотреть труп потерпевшей. Леся осматривает тело жертвы и обнаруживает улику, которую при осмотре упустил криминалист Ройзман. Макаров устраивает Ройзману за это взбучку. Ким заступается за коллегу. В расследовании очередного дела Макаров снова обращается к Берштадскому и рассказывает ему о Инге Кошевой, ее кольце со змейкой и что ее отпечатки пальцев совпадают с отпечатками, найденными на входной двери в квартире Иры. Богдана случайно застает Макарова за разговором с какой-то старушкой, которая просит, чтобы ее "невинно арестованного" внука-инвалида отпустили. Макаров соглашается. Богдана меняет свое мнение о Макарове. Щеглов видит, как Лесю увозит с работы молодой парень-байкер. Киценко начинает его подкалывать. Кинолог Олег рассказывает Инге Кошевой, что выяснил, кто такой Андрей Макаров. Инга обдумывает эту информацию и заявляет Олегу, что намерена нанести Макарову "упреждающий удар".

programme.title: Горячая точка
programme.desc: Сотрудники полиции участвуют во всех особо важных делах – спасении заложников и переговорах с террористами, эвакуации жителей и обезвреживании бомб, охоте на серийного убийцу и даже решении семейных конфликтов. В арсенале у участников ГСР (группы стратегического реагирования) не только высокотехнологичное оружие, но еще и быстрый ум, интуиция и… багаж собственных проблем и травм, которые часто влияют на их работу.

programme.title: Горячая точка
programme.desc: Сотрудники полиции участвуют во всех особо важных делах – спасении заложников и переговорах с террористами, эвакуации жителей и обезвреживании бомб, охоте на серийного убийцу и даже решении семейных конфликтов. programme.title: Контакт
programme.desc: Спецслужбы проводят взрывные работы на участке, где зафиксированы магнитные аномалии. Совершенно случайно в зоне взрыва оказываются три человека: преступник Владимир Голенко, фотохудожник Олег Малинин и неудачливый писатель Венедикт Тартаковский. В результате взрыва между этими людьми возникает странная связь – фотограф Малинин может читать мысли преступника Голенко, и даже видеть окружающий мир его глазами, а писатель Тартаковский может полностью управлять действиями Голенко и при этом общаться с Малининым на расстоянии. Тартаковский, получив в свое полное распоряжение преступника Голенко, решает его руками отомстить всем, кто мешал ему в жизни. Город захлестывает череда кровавых преступлений...

programme.title: Почта
programme.desc: В почтовое отделение на должность экспедитора устраивается Елена (40 лет). Экспедитор Андрей (45) не очень доволен новой напарницей, он не доверяет женщинам за рулем. Но со временем между Еленой и Андреем возникает симпатия. И не без стараний со стороны их детей – Юли и Глеба. Андрей – одинокий папа, Елена - одинокая мама, казалось бы, ничего не может помешать их отношениям… Но тайны и ошибки прошлого сыграют с ними злую шутку… Бушуют страсти и в почтовом отделении. Руководитель отделения Артем (30) покоряет вершины почтовой карьеры и не желает замечать сотрудницу отделения Милану (25), которая мечтает заполучить его сердце. Мама Артема и его младший брат Гена также вносят в жизнь отделения свои коррективы… Все герои ежедневно сталкиваются с нестандартными ситуациями, но не остаются равнодушными к проблемам людей-клиентов почтового отделения, помогая им выпутаться из сложных историй…

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Craig and his two best friends, Kelsey and JP, are always going on adventures in the untamed suburban wilderness known as the Creek - a kid utopia where tribes of children rule over tree forts and bike ramps, making up an entire kid society. Each episode finds the kids either venturing into unexplored areas of the Creek, encountering new Creek Kids, or just getting into trouble at their hang out - the Stump.

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. Clarence lives with his mother Mary and her boyfriend Chad in the fictional town of Aberdale, and he is optimistic, curious, honest and quirky boy, who sees the best in everyone and gets himself in a variety of funny situations and everyday problems, which he solves with lots of imagination and with the help from his friends.

programme.desc: "When Alan ditches Gumball to do something more fun Gumball is desperate to track him down and make him pay for his betrayal. programme.title: Total DramaRama
programme.desc: Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. Any harmless idea of the kids turns out to be a total disaster, they are irrepressible in producing new ideas on how to have fun. the kids are discussing every single decision and plan in front of the cameras just like their adult versions, being a part of a reality show.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

programme.desc: When an unknown figure shows up and insults their Mom the kids are expecting a massive showdown but are surprised when Mom chooses the path of peace. Mom explains Yuki Masami's mother is an old school friend and repeatedly refuses to fight her despite further provocation. However when Yuki threatens to get Mom fired from her job Mom has no choice but to partake in a rematch of a karate match her and Yuki had fought as children.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

programme.title: Total DramaRama
programme.desc: Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. Any harmless idea of the kids turns out to be a total disaster, they are irrepressible in producing new ideas on how to have fun. the kids are discussing every single decision and plan in front of the cameras just like their adult versions, being a part of a reality show.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Amazing World of Gumball revolves around the life of Gumball Watterson a 12-year-old cat who attends middle school in the fictional city of Elmore. Accompanied by his adoptive goldfish brother and best friend Darwin he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city during which he interacts with his other family members - sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard - and an extended supporting cast of characters. With relatable themes and a unique cast of characters The Amazing World of Gumball exemplifies the funny amazing sweet and optimistic side of kids' everyday life. Injected with a good deal of humor and unpredictable nonsense Gumball's world reflects the modern family and everyday issues that kids understand.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: When Darwin asks Gumball to teach him how to skate Gumball makes sure that he covers every aspect of the skating lifestyle - from wearing the right gear using the right terms and choosing the right board. But when Darwin finally gets his wheels rolling he realises there might be one important aspect of skating that Gumball hasn't taught him...

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball‌
programme.desc: Penny wants to ask Gumball to the Elmore Jr High Prom, but when Gumball's expectations for an extra romantic and extra complicated gesture become way more than Penny can handle, Penny must find a way to deliver.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Amazing World of Gumball revolves around the life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year-old cat who attends middle school in the fictional city of Elmore. Accompanied by his adoptive goldfish brother and best friend Darwin, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with his other family members - sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard - and an extended supporting cast of characters. With relatable themes and a unique cast of characters, The Amazing World of Gumball exemplifies the funny, amazing, sweet and optimistic side of kids' everyday life. Injected with a good deal of humor and unpredictable nonsense, Gumball's world reflects the modern family and everyday issues that kids understand.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball sets out to solve the mystery of who stuffed Principal Brown into his locker. / Gumball and Darwin's harmless pranks on Dad spiral hopelessly out of control. / Gumball and Darwin's martial arts costumes make them a laughing stock at school. / Gumball is traumatised when accidentally kissed on the mouth by his Grandma JoJo. / Gumball and Darwin are invited to a high school party and have to bring a date! / Gumball and Darwin unsuccessfully attempt to get a refund for their computer game. / Gumball discovers that Bobert is planning to take over his identity and replace him! / Gumball and Darwin barely survive a school picnic in the Forest of Doom. / Gumball sets out to win his Dad back by winning a blindfolded "dumb" race.

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: CNN Newsroom
programme.desc: CNN Newroom provides the most up to date news as it breaks and is the longest running show on the channel, airing twice a day Monday to Friday and throughout the day over the weekends. CNN has developed a lot since its founding in 1980 by American media proprietor Ted Turner as a 24 hour cable news channel. As an organisation, CNN have won multiple awards, including a network-record six news & documentary Emmy Awards in 2018.

programme.title: Inside Africa
programme.desc: Each week, Inside Africa documentary series on CNN highlights the unique diversity of mysterious Africa, its numerous cultures and religions, peoples, art, music, cuisine, travel and literature, its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna. Watch the interviews with people from various spheres of life and find out more surprising facts about this continent: how it fights for conservation of rare animals, who the new figures in fashion and design are, what the new educational programs for children look like. Everything what Africa is filled with and lives for is in this series.

programme.title: Marketplace Middle East
programme.desc: Business show revolves around cutting edge economic trends and latest business developments in the Middle East. The focus is on the key cities of the region, its most important sectors and industries. The guests of the show are significant representatives of the business community in the region.

programme.title: Marketplace Africa
programme.desc: Unique access to the latest African market information, with a look at events and developments that impact its business world. Follow the business stories that influence the African continent. Eleni Giokos is a CNN correspondent based in the network's Johannesburg bureau and the show's host. Every week she interviews figures of business and industry to reveal the economic trends in various regions of Africa and to present the continent's key sectors and corporations.

programme.title: Connecting Africa
programme.desc: The African continent is going through a big transformation and this CNN magazine presents the entrepreneurs, companies and projects that are working hard to modernise it and make its economic integration possible. programme.title: Inside Politics
programme.desc: Inside Politics is a political talk show, broadcast on CNN and anchored by CNN Chief National Correspondent John King. It features the most important political stories presented by a panel of well-sourced reporters. programme.title: U.S. State of the Union Address
programme.desc: The Speech is addressed to the Congress and the American people. It aims to highlight administration work and its victories, target political enemies and demonstrate the President's vision for the whole country.

programme.title: Fareed Zakaria GPS
programme.desc: Weekly public affairs show hosted by an American journalist, political scientist, and author Fareed Zakaria. The show is broadcasted on CNN every Sunday in many countries of the world. The "GPS" in the show's title stands for "Global Public Square," a reference to the show's focus on international issues and foreign affairs. The guests of the show's one-on-one interviews and roundtable discussions are most prominent figures in the world of global politics, economy and global decision-makers and influencers.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?

From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Reality series focuses on the amazing opportunity to dive into American street racing world. Look at how need for speed unites people and find out what adrenaline addicts are ready for in Oklahoma, unofficial capital of illegal street racing. Only top racers participate in the competition, they want to appear and stay at the A-list, everything they have to do is to try to squeeze as much performance out of their vehicles as possible.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Seg 1 Animation. Animation is the process and technique that involves creating the illusion of movement from still drawings and inanimate objects. It is achieved by displaying images with slight variations in a rapid and successive manner thus making our eyes perceive the illusion of movement. Seg 2 Aviation Illusions. Aviation illusions are the sensory illusions associated with taking flight. When pilots take flight their vestibular system, the sensory system responsible for balance, is affected by conflicting stimulus from what the pilot sees and feels during flight. Seg 3 Spinning Dancer. The spinning dancer illusion is an illusion that was created by Noboyuki Kayahara. One can either perceive the dancer as spinning clockwise or counter clockwise. This phenomenon is explained by Bistable perception which states that perception can be altered subjectively just by how an object is observed. Seg 4 Mirage. Mirages are a physical optical phenomenon that can be observed when there is a difference in the temperature in the surrounding air of an area. The different temperatures of the air causes light to refract and cause weird distortions when viewed at the correct angle. This can range from weird reflections to distortions and even the appearance of floating objects. Seg 5 Rainbow Formation. Rainbows are formed as a result of sunlight being refracted and reflected by tiny drops of water in the atmosphere. The water droplets act as prism that can split the sun's white light into the spectrum of visible colors thus creating the effect of a colorful rainbow.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Seg 1 Iridescence. Iridescence is the phenomenon where surfaces reflect a multitude of colors at once and could change color perspectives upon shifting the angle of viewing. Iridescence is caused by interference, where light gets reflected or cancelled out by the structures of the surfaces. Seg 2 Chemiluminescence. Chemiluminescence is the phenomenon of producing light energy through chemical reactions. The byproduct of a chemiluminescent reaction, instead of heat energy, is a photon or a light particle. Only selected compounds are capable of producing chemiluminescence, usually highly oxidized compounds when reacting with another compound. Seg 3 Bioluminescence. Bioluminescence is a form of chemiluminescence, only that this occurs in living things. Special compounds collectively called as luciferin oxidizes upon catalysis by enzymes called luciferase, producing oxyluciferin. Upon decay, oxyluciferin releases photons or light particles. Bioluminescence serve different functions for each organism, but all for survival purposes. Seg 4 Gemstone Coloration. A gemstone acquires its color through elements that are essential to its structure or through impurities, or elements that replace some of the metallic ions in the structure that will affect which colors in the visible spectrum gets absorbed or reflected. Seg 5 Mechanical Plant Defenses. Mechanical plant defenses demonstrate how survival instincts are incorporated into plant morphologies and physiologies by growing or producing various defensive features such as thorns, spines, and prickles to the less obvious ones like trichomes and raphides and less aggressive forms of defense like thigmonasty.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I simply cannot wait for more!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it. In this series of 20 films, of 26 minutes each, the habitat will be a major showcase revealing our capacity to adapt ourselves at a time where we need to find solutions in order to address immense changes.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Running Southbound outside on Central Coast with a big Tyee Chinook Release finish North of Milbanke Sound!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial - a predator - that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia - a Tiger Quoll - smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin has an age-old problem. He's going bald. But not on his head - on his back! The Loro Parque keepers have a mystery on their hands but all evidence points to two other mischievous monkeys that are so cute - you'd never suspect a thing! Every day Loro Parque keeps a close watch on each and every animal in their care. Today though, keeper Kristina is getting a little closer than usual. She has to perform an ultrasound on Ulysses the dolphin's eye - but can she train Ulysses to keep her eye open long enough to perform the vital test? Time (and patience) will tell. It's not every day one of the cutest chimps in the zoo has a first birthday. And it's not every day Garoe, the one-year old chimp wakes up to a tasty cake hanging in his enclosure. So, what do you get when you combine cakes and chimps - a swinging good time to start!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods - you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups - you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals. The director of The First Cry, Gilles de Maistre has traveled the world in search of children who maintain unusual and special relationships with wild animals. With the strength of innocence, the power of raw faith and the magic of respect, these little princes have found the balance between two worlds in harmony with one another, where child and animal trust each other, learn to know one another, live together and love each other. Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: It's called La Isla Bonita, meaning "the beautiful island", or also La Isla Verde -"the green island" - as it is the greenest of all the Canary Islands. Every few hundred meters, it offers an entirely different and unique view. From tropical cloud forests, to mountain panoramas and volcanic landscapes. La Palma is an incredibly diverse natural paradise. And that is precisely its greatest asset. La Palma is a place that everyone should visit.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The most venomous snake on land. The deserted heart of the Australian outback, where people seldom venture, is the hot, baked home of the most venomous land snake in the world - the inland taipan, a two meter long snake with enough venom in one bite to kill a quarter of a million mice. Gila Monster - North America's largest land lizard, venomous and striking, lives in desert regions. Blue-Ringed Octopus - Tiny but deadly, it carries two venoms—one lethal to humans. Red-Back Spider - Hidden in messy webs, the female's scarlet stripe warns of her deadly bite. Sydney Funnel-Web - Aggressive and armed with toxic venom, the male is especially dangerous. Which venomous creature is the deadliest?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Wildebeest and Zebra - Africa's most famous drifters. Hundreds of thousands of zebra live together in the Serengeti. Their distinctive eye-catching stripes are as unique as fingerprints and even within the largest of gatherings no two zebra will be found with exactly the same stripes. Turtles that make epic journeys to reproduce. The most abundant sea turtle in the world, Olive Ridleys' have extraordinary nesting habits. These small turtles migrate massive distances between their oceanic feeding grounds and the shores that draw them back to mate, and then to nest. Sooty Tern - Sea birds that don't come to land for years. Like the turtle, once it has left land for the first time, a young Sooty Tern may not go back for years, spending all its time in the ocean skies until it is time for it to breed. Soaring on outstretched wings, these elegant seabirds feed almost entirely on the fish driven to the surface by the hunters below. Australian Pelicans - Water birds that follow ephemeral rivers. Pelicans – these quirky, comical, big billed birds are usually thought of as spending all their time around coasts and harbors. They are widespread in Australia's lakes, rivers, billabongs and estuaries – or other waterway with enough food for their fish-loving lifestyle. The whales and whale sharks that roam the great oceans. Some of the greatest migratory animals on earth are those that live in its waters and traverse its great oceans. From baleen whales that travel from the nutrient rich polar waters and the whale sharks whose migrations we barely understand.

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: They're beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They're lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they're wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic - all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution. In the Florida Keys, some practical and novel approaches are making progress in the fight against these Toxic Invaders.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Deserts are dry. Deserts are extreme. True deserts get less than 18 cm of rain per year. True deserts have very few plants. Semi-desert habitats have enough rainfall to support more plant and animal life. Either way, deserts are not easy places for animals to live. Desert animals have evolved to handle the desert's heat and lack of water. They have adapted their bodies and behaviors to the desert climate. Most can survive on small amounts of water and many get all of their water from their food. Some drink maybe once a week and travel considerable distances to find isolated waterholes and springs. Large animals seek shade during the hottest part of the day. Some animals dig a hollow depression into the ground and lie in the cooler soil while others are nocturnal. Many reptiles and other animals protect themselves from the extreme temperature by spending their time in burrows. The scorpion is one of the most ancient creatures on earth, in existence since life first crawled out of the sea. One look and you can see why they're born survivors. Not only are their bodies armoured against the desert heat - and other predators - but all scorpions have pincers at the front and a poisonous sting at the end of their tail. Rattlesnakes can be two meters long. They're fast, tough and with a deadly venom, making them one of the most dangerous snakes in the world. But nobody seems to have told the Roadrunner, who regard rattlesnakes as quite suitable prey.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: These are Nature's own Battletanks, and (with the exception of the Indian Elephant), all endemic to the African continent. The African Savannah is the stage for thousands of battles every day. How do elephants, these large, cumbersome creatures survive and even prosper on a diet that even the strictest vegetarian would pass on! Well for one thing, most other animals get out of their way. But lions and hyenas are not always so easily moved – they prey on young, sick and old elephants in particular. This seemingly gentle giant has been revealed to have a darker side in the last few years too. They may survive on just plant life, but that doesn't mean they don't like a fight – to the death. Elephants have been observed attacking and killing Rhinos in the last 20 years. It's a savage clash. Meanwhile, the Rhino, a tough looking customer if ever there was one, is an endangered species. When the great herds go on the search for food, predators go on the hunt for them. If ever there was an animal that seems destined to survive, it's the Rhino, which has been around for over 6 million years. But it too has an enemy: mankind – the deadliest foe of all. Then there's the hippopotamus. An adult hippo is a huge, aggressive animal, and even the largest crocodiles tend to stay away from it. However, when baby hippos stray from their mothers, then crocodiles, lions and hyenas will have a go if they can get away without being attacked themselves by adults in the baby hippo's herd. That's why baby hippos must stay close to Mum

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity…

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where, in the past few years, diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan joins world-renown cave explorer Brian Kakuk to investigate the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world! The formations in this cave are simply stunning, and incredibly unique.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. But to find out, Jonathan has to brave some very cold water. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Few substances in history have had as profound an effect on mankind as gunpowder and yet its discovery was probably an accident! A big bang, for one… Records show that the Chinese were aware of the explosive stuff as early as 300AD. The invention of gunpowder is a bit of a mystery, and so are its ingredients: it was made by mixing sulfur (a yellow stone- hiding deep underground), charcoal (burned wood), and saltpeter (or potassium nitrate) which was the white frosting found on poop that had been given time to settle and get comfortable. As you can imagine, it takes some effort to make gunpowder. But, rulers needed gunpowder. Gunpowder needed saltpeter. And saltpeter needed poop. And so, dukes declared a monopoly on their lands' waste. Until, only 500 years after the Chinese discovered it, we found out why secretions have such an explosive character. It turns out to be caused by microscopic bacteria, which produce the nitrates as byproducts of digestion. The reason why gunpowder explodes is that it burns very fast, and when it burns it releases gases that have a bigger volume than the original powder (similar to how steam is bigger than water is). But the gunpowder from the old days gave off so much smoke that battlefields were literally too smoky to aim. Until, in 1888, Albert Nobel invented a dense smokeless powder explosive called ballistite. And now, is gunpowder about to be replaced?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Mankind has been flying for over a century. As early as the 1500s Leonardo da Vinci tried to build a flying machine. Drawing inspiration from birds he gave it wings. Unfortunately, his "Ornithopter" didn't work, and indeed, the airplanes of today do not have flapping wings! We also tried it with balloons. Huge 245-metre long airships that needed the guts of between 80,000 to 200,000 cows! But, it was the kite that became the forerunner of the flying machine. A kite made by the now famous Wright brothers. The two brothers were bicycle repairmen, which convinced them that a flying machine could be highly unstable and yet controllable, such as with bicycles. They built their kites as strong as their bicycle frames and used bicycle parts to test their workings. The early Wright planes could manage no more than 65 km/h. Nowadays, a commercial plane can top 800 km/h. What is it that make our current planes fly 12 times faster? Well, one British Royal Air pilot, Frank Whittle, remembered his school experiments with the 'Aeolipile', a piece of ancient Greek engineering. This pilot argued that we could fly faster - if we'd fly higher - because there is less air resistance at high altitudes. The future of aviation has lead to Airbus's A380, the largest passenger plane in the world as well as the scramjet built by NASA. So what will be the next quirky discovery for flight?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Did you know the potato chip was invented out of anger? Or that "Sweet 'N Low" was named after a song? Or the real truth of why we say "God Bless You" after a sneeze? These questions and more are answered and explained in a new series called "Wow, I Never Knew That!" from Executive Producer Whoopi Goldberg, Tom Leonardis and the Emmy award- winning production company David Harris Katz Entertainment, Inc. "Wow I Never Knew That!" is a whimsical, half-hour television series that is jam-packed with exciting tidbits and fascinating facts that uncover the truths and origins behind the stuff you're already familiar with. From the items you use every day to the phrases you use in conversation to the habits you're so accustomed to, you'll be fascinated to learn how they've all really come about!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: On a hot summer's day, nothing cools you down like a frozen fruity popsicle! You'll learn how an 11-year old boy created this sweet icy treat! And, have you ever noticed those colored spinning poles outside the barbershop? You'll be in stitches when you learn how they got their start! Plus, find out how a melting chocolate bar gave way to the invention of the microwave!

programme.title: Inside Outer Space

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Seg 1 Visually-Evoked Auditory Response. VEAR or Visually Evoked Auditory response is the type of auditory perception where our brains perceive to hear sounds in response to seeing something. In the case of the jumping pylon illusion, a thud sound is perceived even though there is no sound accompanying the animation. Seg 2 Retinal Fatigue. Retinal fatigue is the term used to describe the condition when the photoreceptors in our eyes become tired or strained due to staring at one color for extend periods of time. The effect causes an afterimage of the complementary color to appear out of nowhere and will be temporarily visible for a few seconds. Seg 3 Müller-Lyer illusion. The Müller-Lyer illusion is an optical illusion where parallel lines of the same length appear longer when perceived with different pointed arrowheads drawn at the ends. Possible explanations suggest that our minds tend to look at overall length rather than just the line's parts or segments when processing the image. Another possible explanation is that our minds tendency to look at angled lines and perceive patterns of depth. Seg 4 Ames Room. The Ames room is a specially constructed room that features a distorted and skewed floor plan. when viewed from one angle, our brain is tricked into thinking that the perspective of the rooms is normal but when a person walks from one end to another the distorted floor angle makes it look as if the person changes size drastically. Seg 5 Synesthesia. Synesthesia is a genetic condition that is present in at least 4% of the human population. People with synesthesia have hyper connected neurons that allow them to perceive a stimuli as interconnected with different senses. An example of which is the ability to see color while hearing sounds.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Seg 1 Chromatic Adaptation. Chromatic adaptation is the ability of humans to adjust to changes in brightness to keep up with the appearance of colors. this is the reason why we are able to perceive colors properly even though lighting in real environments change constantly. Seg 2 Color-changing animals. Color changing in animals are developed adaptations which the animals use for various applications such as signaling their species or as a way to hide from predators. Animals that can change color have specialized cells called chromatophores that can alter pigmentation and light reflecting properties. Seg 3 How do we see the color pink. We are able to see pink because our brains are able to perceive variations in light and color. Although pink as a wavelength does not exist in the light spectrum, it is our brains that processes light in a such a way that we are able to perceive combinations of colors thus giving us a way to see colors like pink. Seg 4 Blue wings, blue feathers. Blue rarely exists in nature. But due to evolution, structural features in the wings and feathers of some animals allow light to bend in ways that make it possible to reflect the color blue. Seg 5 Snow camouflage. Snow camouflage, is a type of camouflage that certain creatures use to hide during winter. It is typically characterised by differing shades of grays and whites.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.desc: We explore the capital of India. The bustling metropolis is filled with modern skyscrapers that stand side-by-side with hundreds of ancient monuments, making Delhi a physical dichotomy of yesterday and tomorrow. "Wow I Never Knew That!" is a whimsical, half-hour television series that is jam-packed with exciting tidbits and fascinating facts that uncover the truths and origins behind the stuff you're already familiar with. From the items you use every day to the phrases you use in conversation to the habits you're so accustomed to, you'll be fascinated to learn how they've all really come about!

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Throughout the history of mankind - the business of curing, of understanding and treating disease, has taken a rather peculiar path. Some procedures have proven to be very efficient while other methods could only have made things worse for the patient. Up to the 16th Century "treating" someone could mean diminishing one of four bodily fluids, paving the way for bloodletting. As it turns out, modern science proves that bloodletting does help in rare cases. In fact, bloodsucking leeches are excellent helpers to cure wounds. We now know that one little creature is the cause for many diseases: bacteria. But until the mid-19th century, many felt that such tiny organisms such as germs could not possibly kill larger ones such as humans. After all, we can't even see them with the naked eye! How then, did we discover them? Thanks to one doctor who decided to take a good look …between his teeth. Since then, we have found a cure for most bacterial infections in the form of Antibiotics. This was accidently discovered by Alexander Fleming - whilst leaving the office for a holiday, he left a culture plate smeared with his personal nasal mucus on his lab bench only to find that mould surrounding this mucus actually inhibited its growth. In the new millennium, this discovery of such a "Superdrug" is threatened by the advent of the 'Superbug'. Have these cures led to bacteria becoming more tolerant and harder to kill? What else will the future bring? A cure against the flu?

programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: The R.I.P. Files features a group of paranormal investigators, who use intuitive abilities and a deep knowledge of metaphysical techniques to interact with the entities they encounter at haunted locations. They encourage the spirits to share their stories in their own words through amazing EVPs and other evidence that is bridging the gap between the worlds of science and spirituality.

programme.desc: Kad svētki sāk aprimt, raksturi pierimst un kāds pazūd. Dažas dienas vēlāk kādas Ziemeļkalifornijas pilsētas nolaistā daļā tiek uziets ķermenis. Kad lietas virzība apstājas, būs vajadzīgs ļoti negaidīts notikums, lai beidzot notvertu slepkavu.

programme.title: Noslepkavots no rīta
programme.desc: Mīklainos apstākļos izceļas ugunsgrēks dzīvoklī, un izmeklētāji pārbauda gruvešus, lai atklātu notikumus, kas noveda pie šīs katastrofas. Atkājas, ka tā nebija nejaušība, un sākas darbs, lai slepkavu iesēdinātu aiz restēm.

programme.title: Noslepkavots no rīta
programme.desc: Sandjego Action Sports konvencija kļūst nāvējoša. Pēc nakts ballītēm Gaslamp rajonā pazudis praktikants mārketingā. Pierādījumu gūzma ved izmeklētājus pie šokējoša atklājuma.

programme.title: Noslepkavots no rīta
programme.desc: Izsmalcinātā Koralgeiblsas kopiena Floridā tiek satricināta līdz pamatiem - nakts vidū tiek sašauts viens no elites pārstāvjiem un vēl viens noslepkavots. Likumsargi ir apņēmušies nomedīt bīstamu slepkavu.

programme.title: Noslepkavots no rīta
programme.desc: Populārs pusaudzis pēc kempinga ceļojuma tiek atrasts miris, un nelielā Oklahomas pilsētiņa ir satricināta. Satiekoties ar vairākiem aizdomās turamajiem, tiesībsargiem slepkavas notveršanā jānodala fakti no izdomājumiem.

programme.title: Džona F. Kenedija slepkavība
programme.desc: Tas bija noziegums, kas satrieca un mainīja ASV. Šis aizraujošais dokumentālais stāsts, kas aplūko liktenīgos 1963. gada 22. novembra notikumus, kad tika noslepkavots prezidents Džons F. Kenedijs. Dokumentālais darbs no trim dažādiem skatpunktiem pēta prezidenta drošības vadītāja Roja Kellermena, slepkavas Lī Hārvija Osvalda un pirmās lēdijas Džekijas Kenedijas darbības pirms apšaudes.

programme.title: Pazudis
programme.desc: Sieva, māte un bībeles skolotāja Lina Mesere pazudusi no ģimenes fermas netālu no Seintdženevīvas Misuri. Viņas divi dēli, divas māsas, vietējais šerifs un pat visa komūna izmisīgi meklē viņu vairāk nekā divus gadus. Bet tad..

programme.title: Pazudis
programme.desc: Pēc skolas 2015. gada 1. septembrī mājās nepārrodas jaunais Masīns Smits. Viņa vecāki raizējas un ir nobažījušies par sava jaunākā bērna drošību un viņu piemeklējušo likteni.

programme.title: Slepkavība brīvdienās
programme.desc: Vīrietis, kurš valkā vilka masku, Helovīnā nodūra sievieti un viņas nedzimušo bērnu. Izmeklētājiem ir jānomierina sabiedrība un jāatrod slepkava, pirms viņš uzbrūk atkal.

programme.title: Slepkavība brīvdienās
programme.desc: Jauna sieviete, kas ieradusies mājās no koledžas, tiek nogalināta un viņas nonāvēšanas rīki izrādās rullītis un grebšanas nazis, ko ģimene plānoja izmantot Pateicības dienas vakariņās. Izmeklētājiem ir grūti atrisināt šīs svētku šausmas.

programme.title: Luīze Vudvorda – slepkava vai upure?
programme.desc: Pirms 25 gadiem, 1997. gadā, pasauli satricināja tiesas prāva, kurā Luīze Vudvorda, 18 gadus veca "au pair" auklīte no Lielbritānijas, kas strādāja Bostonā ASV, tika apsūdzēta un notiesāta par mazuļa nogalināšanu. Prokurors apgalvoja, ka mazulis miris no spēcīgas kratīšanas. Tagad Luīze ir pusmūžā, audzina savu meitu, un kaimiņi par viņu saka, ka viņa ir tāda pati māmiņa kā citas. 2022. gadā uzņemtais britu dokumentālais miniseriāls izrevidē tiesas prāvas gaitu un jautā, cik taisnīgs bija tiesas spriedums.

programme.title: Noslepkavots no rīta
programme.desc: Šī ir tāda pati nakts kā visas pārējās vietējā bārā Vaithausas ciematā Ohaio. Tas ir - līdz skūpsts izraisa domino efektu, kas kļūst nāvējošs. Izmeklētāji izsijā graudus no pelavām, lai konstatētu, ka viņu aizdomās turamo saraksts ar katru stundu kļūst garāks.

programme.title: Pazudis
programme.desc: 21 gadu vecā Kortne Stoufere kādā nakrī pazūd no savas gultas. Izmeklētāji pārbauda dažādus pavedienus un versijas, bet jaunā skaistule nekur nav atrodama. Viņas ģimene turpina bezgalīgi cerēt uz labāko.

programme.title: Slepkavība brīvdienās
programme.desc: Reaģējot uz laupīšanu sporta preču veikalā Ziemassvētku vakarā, Teksasas štata Ērvingas pilsētas policists tiek aukstasinīgi nošauts. Tiek atklāta slepkavu identitāte, un lieta pārvēršas valsts mēroga medībās.

programme.title: Algota slepkavība
programme.desc: Policija nosūta slepenu informatoru ar uzdevumu noskaidrot, vai viņu draugs un ārsts vēlas nogalināt savu atsvešināto sievu. Vai varbūt tas ir tikai viņa greizsirdīgās draudzenes plāns?

programme.title: Helter Skelter: Amerikāņu mīts
programme.desc: Tikko no cietuma izlaistais, "Helter Skelter" seko topošajam mūziķim Mensonam un viņa jaunajai "ģimenei" Losandželosā. Tajā viņš satiekas ar rokenrola karalisko aprindu pārstāvjiem un gandrīz noslēdz ierakstu līgumu.

programme.desc: Šī ir tāda pati nakts kā visas pārējās vietējā bārā Vaithausas ciematā Ohaio. Tas ir - līdz skūpsts izraisa domino efektu, kas kļūst nāvējošs. Izmeklētāji izsijā graudus no pelavām, lai konstatētu, ka viņu aizdomās turamo saraksts ar katru stundu kļūst garāks.

programme.title: Pazudis
programme.desc: 21 gadu vecā Kortne Stoufere kādā nakrī pazūd no savas gultas. Izmeklētāji pārbauda dažādus pavedienus un versijas, bet jaunā skaistule nekur nav atrodama. Viņas ģimene turpina bezgalīgi cerēt uz labāko.

programme.title: Duo Mix
programme.desc: Nakts programma ar mūzikas video dažādām gaumēm. Dejojiet, dziediet līdzi vai izbaudiet, guļot zem segas.

programme.title: Draugi
programme.desc: Seriāla galvenie varoņi ir seši draugi - Reičela, Monika, Fēbe, Džoijs, Čendlers un Ross, kuri dzīvo kaimiņos un regulāri nonāk aizraujošās un ļoti komiskās situācijās.

programme.title: Kas notiek krēslā
programme.desc: Ņujorkas pievārtē kādā senlaicīgā un baisā Steitenailendas mājā mitinās iedzīvotāji, kuru dzīve lielākoties sākas iestājoties tumsai. Nama stāvus apdzīvo trīs asinsūcēji vampīri - Nandors, Lazlo un Nadja -, enerģijas vampīrs Kolins Robinsons, kurš strādā birojā un ar savu nomācošo klātbūtni izsūc enerģiju saviem kolēģiem, un Giljermo, Nadīnas paziņa. Kā jau kārtīgi vampīri, viņi ir vairākus gadsimtus seni, un iekļaušanās mūsdienu pasaulē tiem nereti sagādā galvassāpes. Trešajā sezonā vampīri iegūs jaunu spēka līmeni un sastapsies ar vampīru, no kura ir cēlušies visi pārējie vampīri.

programme.title: Kas notiek krēslā
programme.desc: Nandora mīlas meklējumi beidzot rezultējas panākumiem, bet Nadja apjauš, ka viņas mūža lielākā ambīcija ir atvērt savu vampīru naktsklubu.

programme.title: Amerikāņu ģimenīte
programme.desc: Lūks tiek apcietināts, un Fils ir pārsteiguts par Klēras reakciju. Mičels apsver jaunu darba piedāvājumu, kamēr Kamerons palīdz Glorijai uziet viņas dzimtas mērces slepeno recepti. Tikmēr Džejs gatavojas saņemt Tirdzniecības palātas apbalvojumu.

programme.title: Amerikāņu ģimenīte
programme.desc: Heilija iezogas greznā savrupmājā, ko Fils mēģina pārdot, lai beidzot pabūtu viena, taču izrādās, ka līdzīga doma bijusi citiem mājiniekiem. Tikmēr Džejs klusībā plāno ģimenes brīvdienas, bet Menijs mēģina izmantot brālīti Džo kā "ēsmu", lai iepazītos meiteni.

programme.title: Amerikāņu ģimenīte
programme.desc: Glorija apmaksā grupas terapijas seansu visiem trim pāriem, taču neviens to neuztver nopietni. Tikmēr Heilija un Aleksa spriež, vai abām nebūtu laiks pamest savus puišus.

programme.title: Amerikāņu ģimenīte
programme.desc: Glorija ieplānojusi ģimenei īstus "Baltos Ziemassvētkus", taču laikapstākļi nevēlas sadarboties. Džejs pieņem lēmumu par sava uzņēmuma nākotni, bet Aleksa atrod jaunu draugu. Tikmēr Heilija un Endijs turpina slepus nodoties savam dēkai.

programme.title: Amerikāņu ģimenīte
programme.desc: Danfiju bērni pēdējā brīdī gatavo dzimšanas dienas pārsteigumu Mičelam un nejauši sastop Reju Liotu. Džejs jūtas neērti Džo jaunā drauga tēva sabiedrībā, savukārt Klēra lūdz Filu neuzstāt uz pusdienu rēķina apmaksu. Tikmēr Kems palīdz Lilijai ar viņas pirmo simpātiju.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Pēc sava ilggadējā friziera nāves Als palaiž brīvībā savus matus, nevis pacieš vizīti pie jauna stilista salonā... kurā strādā sievietes. Kad Als padodas un dodas uz salonu, viņam izveido ļoti sliktu frizūru, kas liek viņam izskatīties pēc sievietes.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Izmisušie Als un Stīvs liek kopā galvas, meklējot risinājumus gaidāmajai plikpaurībai. Stīvs sāk pamanīt savu matu līniju atkāpšanos, savukārt Alam tas ir pilnīgi vienalga. Neveiksmīgi izmēģinājis matu toniku, Stīvs mēģina pievienoties plikpaurīgo vīriešu klubam Bald American Dudes (B.A.D.) un atved sev līdzi Alu, kurš rīko tikšanos apavu veikalā.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Bandiji dodas uz greznu restorānu, lai iztērētu lielu naudu — mantojuma čeku par 237 dolāriem no Pegijas tēvoča. Taču kļūst acīmredzams, ka izsmalcinātas pusdienas sabiedriskās vietās nav daļa no disfunkcionālo Bandiju dzīvesveida. Situācija pasliktinās, kad Als aizmirst paņemt līdzi maku.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Kellija uzaicina Pegiju uz savas skolas karjeras dienas prezentācijām.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Al beidzot pārliecina Pegiju ieguldīties mājsaimniecības finansēs, taču jūtas satriekts, kad Pegija sāk nest mājās "uzdevumus" no sava kosmētikas pārdošanas darba, nopelnot vairāk naudas nekā Als. Ala jaunais nepilnas slodzes darbs nevar atgriezt viņu ģimenes apgādnieka statusā. Kad Als atrod grāmatu, kurā ir Pegijas klientu vārdi, situācija kļūst sliktāka.

programme.title: Jaunais Šeldons
programme.desc: Iepazīstieties - bērns ģēnijs vārdā Šeldons Kūpers (ar viņu kā pieaugušo būsiet jau satikušies seriālā "Lielā sprādziena teorija") un viņa ģimene. Sociāli savādo Šeldonu dzīvē vajā dažādi unikāli izaicinājumi.

programme.title: Divarpus vīri
programme.desc: Divi brāļi nevarētu būt dažādāki - Čārlijam ir viss, ko dzīvē var vēlēties - nauda, skaista māja okeāna piekrastē, pavisam nedaudz darāmā un neskaitāmas draudzenes, turpretī Alans ir īsts neveiksminieks - tikko no viņa ir izšķīrusies sieva, kura ir paturējusi sev abu kopīgi iegādāto māju, un Alans nespēj savilkt kopā galus, lai samaksātu rēķinus. Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.

programme.title: Ofiss
programme.desc: Ofisā, kura darbinieki nodarbojas ar papīra pārdošanu un piegādi, viss ir tāpat kā lielākajā daļā pasaules ofisu - tajā ir boss, tajā ir dažādi darbinieki, no kuriem dažs labs vien darbu tikai imitē, un starp visiem izveidojušās ofisa attiecības tādā kā piespiedu kārtā - labākas un arī ne tik labas. Kā jau ar kolēģiem. Ofisa vadītājs Maikls, kuru attēlo slavenais aktieris un komiķis Stīvs Karels, savus darbiniekus ik dienas cenšas iesaistīt savos izgudrotajos jokos un uzdevumos. Viņš pats domā, ka ir pasaules labākais boss, ko apliecina krūzīte ar uzrakstu - "Pasaules labākais boss". Diemžēl šo krūzīti viņš sev nopircis pats. Maikls cenšas būt draudzīgs pret saviem darbiniekiem, tomēr lielākā daļa viņa joku ir rasistiski, šovinistiski vai citādi aizskaroši.

Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.

programme.title: Amerikāņu ģimenīte
programme.desc: Danfiju bērni pēdējā brīdī gatavo dzimšanas dienas pārsteigumu Mičelam un nejauši sastop Reju Liotu. Džejs jūtas neērti Džo jaunā drauga tēva sabiedrībā, savukārt Klēra lūdz Filu neuzstāt uz pusdienu rēķina apmaksu. Tikmēr Kems palīdz Lilijai ar viņas pirmo simpātiju.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni

Kāds pieklauvē pie ārdurvīm, un Als pārliecina Stīvu izdarīt pirmo sitienu... un Stīvs galu galā izkaujas ar liliputu.

Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Al beidzot pārliecina Pegiju ieguldīties mājsaimniecības finansēs, taču jūtas satriekts, kad Pegija sāk nest mājās "uzdevumus" no sava kosmētikas pārdošanas darba, nopelnot vairāk naudas nekā Als. Ala jaunais nepilnas slodzes darbs nevar atgriezt viņu ģimenes apgādnieka statusā. Kad Als atrod grāmatu, kurā ir Pegijas klientu vārdi, situācija kļūst sliktāka.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Vedot Pegiju atpakaļ no video veikala, Stīvs iekļūst satiksmē, un Pegija kādam vadītājam parāda pirkstu. Pēcāk Stīvs lūdz Bandijus nākt uz viņa un Mārsijas māju, lai noskatītos dažus video. Viņš baidās no atriebības - kad vīrietis viņam sekos mājās. Kāds pieklauvē pie ārdurvīm, un Als pārliecina Stīvu izdarīt pirmo sitienu... un Stīvs galu galā izkaujas ar liliputu.

programme.title: Kas notiek krēslā
programme.desc: Nadjas naktskluba atklāšanas diena ir apdraudēta - savu uzstāšanos atcēlis kāds ievērojams mūziķis.

programme.title: Kas notiek krēslā
programme.desc: Vampīri devušies ceļojumā uz slepeno Nakts tirgu, kur uz tirgošanos un laika kopā pavadīšanu satiekas visas pārdabiskās būtnes.

Скажи мне правду
programme.desc: В центре сюжета – история обычной домохозяйки Анастасии. Ее благополучный мир, который она с такой любовью выстраивала, оказывается под угрозой: мужа Игоря арестовывают, а у маленькой дочки обнаруживают тяжелую болезнь. Настя не сдается и делает все, чтобы помочь близким. Но внезапно она узнает об изменах Игоря – и это становится для нее жестоким ударом. Как наша героиня поступит: простит супруга или начнет жизнь с чистого листа?

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: 40+, или Геометрия чувств
programme.desc: Маша, Настя и Оля — три закадычные подруги, которых объединяет давняя юношеская мечта о счастливом будущем. Их желания действительно сбылись, но не так, как они представляли. Маша добилась успеха и богатства, построив впечатляющую карьеру, но при этом осталась одинока. Неожиданная встреча с Никитой, человеком из её прошлого, может изменить всё. Оля живёт с талантливым, но невостребованным мужем. Чувствуя себя несчастной и непонятой, она готова на решительные шаги, чтобы вернуть себе ощущение радости. Настя счастлива в браке и кажется, что у неё идеальная семья. Однако в 40 лет она так и не смогла стать матерью, и это не даёт ей покоя.

programme.title: 40+, или Геометрия чувств
programme.desc: Если хочешь насмешить Бога, поделись с ним своими планами, гласит пословица. И судьбы трех подруг - тому доказательство. Когда-то Маша, Оля и Настя нагадали себе счастливую жизнь, и все как будто бы сбылось, только словно в кривом зеркале. Маша достигает небывалых высот в карьере, но все равно остается одинокой и никак не может оправиться от предательства первой любви. У Оли отношения с мужем складываются хуже некуда. Встреча с другим женатым мужчиной переворачивает ее жизнь. Настя чувствует себя счастливой в браке, однако скрывает что-то, что может навредить семье. Сумеют ли наши героини, пройдя через сложные испытания, обрести силы? Не побоятся ли они изменить свои жизни и стать счастливыми?

programme.title: Окно жизни
programme.desc: Славик и Надежда оказываются жертвами квартирных аферистов, поэтому после рождения второго ребёнка они вынуждены жить с семьёй Славика. Его сестра Алёна недовольна таким соседством. Славик уезжает на заработки. Пользуясь тем, что Славик в коме, Алёна выгоняет Надежду с детьми из квартиры. После длительных скитаний Надежда оставляет младенца в бэби-боксе. Соколова и Борадзе предлагают Глаше уволиться по собственному желанию. Борадзе сообщает коллективу о том, что подкидыша усыновила семья Нескоромовых. Коллектив перинатального центра прощается с Милославской - сердце коллеги остановилось. Славик выходит из комы, Алёна признается ему в своем вранье.

programme.title: Любовь с ароматом кофе
programme.desc: Красавица Аля – мать-одиночка, работает баристой и воспитывает 5-ти летнего сына. Бывший парень бросил ее одну с ребенком. Девушка долго никого не подпускала к себе, пока не встретила мажора Гошу. И впервые за долгое время подумала, что он ― тот мужчина, с которым можно шагать по жизни легко и просто. Но Гоша бросает девушку. В это время Аля встречает друга Гоши Костю, который предлагает ей сделку: сыграть роль его несносной, бесцеремонной невесты, чтобы семья перестала думать о женитьбе Кости. Но все идет не по плану….
